query:
SELECT r.id AS "id!: ResourceId"
              FROM unnest($2::uuid[]) AS given(id)
              LEFT JOIN resource_alias a
                     ON a.tenant_id = $1 AND a.historical_id = given.id
              JOIN resource r
                     ON r.tenant_id = $1
                    AND r.id = COALESCE(a.current_id, given.id)
